scope: Qwen3-8B TP4 ROM dies plus KV die/package, AR only

findings.evidence: Existing STREAM4 service emits sector-derived tile kvw data/masks and accepts kvd; legacy boundary moves resident KV toward ROM tiles. Selected package requires local KV-die attention and only attention results returned.

findings.required: Published precision/packing/order, endpoints, clocks, finite credits, bytes per layer, physical link capacity and latency; do not infer from old sector wire.

findings.evidence: Current SYS sequencer consumes kv_ok/kv_write_drained and has d_start/token/pos/gen plus sticky d_done; package join must preserve actual AR command acceptance, result consumption and write visibility rather than translating wire delivery into completion.

findings.required: Native32PC DATA/SIDECAR arbitration, true WR completion and shared native host o_cr; source owner reports seq11/class10 collision and forbids naive header normalization.

model_requirements.outbound: sum of actual Q and new K/V wire bits per rank/layer, including published metadata/protection/padding
model_requirements.inbound: actual attention-result wire bits per rank/layer plus control
model_requirements.serialization: ceil(actual frame bits / published usable link bits per edge), including finite-credit stalls
model_requirements.latency: ROM producer rounding/packing + crossing/serialization + KV attention service + return crossing/serialization + ROM consumer capture, composed over36layers; shared or per-rank link allocation must be explicit
model_requirements.topology: fourTP endpoints; no TP8 and no resident KV-window traffic across package

prohibited: new routes before Claude structural review
